v.s: Leomord gains a 150( +50% Total Physical Attack) shield and begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500( +180% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) to enemies hit (scales with channel time) and slowing them by 40% for 1s.\nLeomord can cast this skill again to actively interrupt the channeling.

The main DPS skill for human state Leomord takes a long time to charge but could be released early to ensure high hit rate. The shield gained by releasing the skill is surprising useful during a tight match or when Leomord is low in health.
Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300( +50% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

Human state skill 2 and mounted state skill 2 are both teleport skills but they don’t share CD. Take advantage of this and Leomord could teleport twice when summoning Barbiel with the ultimate, making it possible to cut into fights quicker.

Leomord summons (Barbiel) to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 350( +100% Total Physical Attack) (Physical Damage) to all enemies in its path.\nIf (Barbiel) comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 30% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.\n(Mounted State): Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 60 Movement Speed and 30 Physical & Magic Defense.

This is the strongest skill of Leomord. Mounting on Barbiel makes him incredibly strong. Barbiel could even knocks back enemies when running. But make sure Leomord comes in contact with Barbiel, otherwise the bonus will not be triggered.
Leomord's Basic Attacks are guaranteed to Crit against enemies below 50% Max HP, dealing 200% damage.\nLeomord converts every 1% Crit Chance gained into 1 Physical Attack.

Passive effects make it easy for Leomord to finish off low-HP units. Making good use of 2 other skills in the mounted state, and Leomord could cut into fights and reduce enemies’ HP to below 30% and slay them with basic attacks in combination with skill “Inspire”.
Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

Unique Passive - Fighting Spirit: Dealing damage grants 12 extra Physical Attack and 2% extra Spell Vamp per second for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Deal 10% extra True Damage according to Base Damage at full stacks.####[C8This effect is reduced to 50% for Marksmen, Mages, and Supports.]
Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).
Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).
Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).
